about:
Mubea Coil Spring Wire operates from Florence, Kentucky, as part of the global Mubea group. The company is led by CEO Thomas Muhr and follows a corporate philosophy known as "The Mubea Way," which emphasizes innovation, employee commitment, and customer focus. No founding year or ownership details for the Florence location are publicly disclosed.

The group develops and manufactures components for vehicle chassis, car bodies, and engines, specializing in lightweight construction technologies that reduce weight and CO2 emissions. Globally, Mubea employs approximately 17,200 people across 70 locations in 22 countries and generates annual revenue of €3.6 billion. Specific facility size, production volumes, or part numbers for the Florence operation are not provided.

Mubea serves the automotive and aviation industries, as well as the emerging micro-mobility sector. The company positions itself as a partner for original equipment manufacturers in these sectors and also operates an aftermarket division, Mubea Aftermarket Services, supplying original spare parts.

The company states that its differentiation lies in deep in-house production expertise, a strategy of high value-added depth, and a culture that encourages employees to contribute ideas. Its products are designed to make vehicles more sustainable through weight reduction, and the organization highlights corporate social responsibility and sustainable production at its worldwide locations.
